Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical unit conversion error. In the analysis of the Hangjin Rear Banner search results, the Planner read the figure "20.87 万人" (20.87 wan ren) as "20.87 million". In Chinese, "万" (wan) represents ten thousand (10,000). Therefore, 20.87 万人 equals 208,700 (20.87 * 10,000), not 20,870,000. The Planner incorrectly treated the number as if it were in millions, leading to the false conclusion that Hangjin Rear Banner has a population larger than Shanghai. The correct comparison is Shanghai (~24.87 million) vs. Hangjin Rear Banner (~0.21 million), making Shanghai significantly larger.
